title: Show Your Friend Mode
goal: Read out loud so a grown-up can hear what you made!
mascot_lines: Sharing your game with a friend is one of the best parts of building.
Watch where your friend gets confused — those spots are clues for what to fix.
Listen kindly to feedback, but you don't have to use every idea.
Pick the comments that make sense to you, and leave the rest.

lines: I tell the computer what to do.
I share it with my family. Yay!

tier2.rephrase: Read each line out loud. Then click Next to keep going.

tier3.nudge: You finish when you reach the LAST line. Keep clicking Next until you see the smile!
